stages.title: Source and contract audit
stages.evidence_note: Historical source and contract inventory verified.

stages.title: Runtime and application architecture
stages.evidence_note: Runtime, dispatcher, content negotiation, build and private workspace architecture implemented and locally verified.

stages.title: Distinctive luminous design system
stages.evidence_note: Original luminous design and shared public/private controls implemented; inspected fixture evidence does not replace final accessibility acceptance.

stages.title: Public website
stages.evidence_note: Public routes implemented; approved owner content/contact/privacy facts and hosted acceptance pending.

stages.title: Secure access and first-login flow
stages.evidence_note: Refresh, callback, recovery/reset, invitation status, current notices, and role routing implemented; real account/email/provider acceptance pending.

stages.title: Trainee workflows
stages.evidence_note: All eight trainee routes integrated with scoped reads and commands; hosted persisted role flows pending.

stages.title: Coach workflows
stages.evidence_note: All ten coach routes integrated, including authoring, release, monitoring, reconciliation and administration; real data and independent approvals pending.

stages.title: Operations, support and recovery
stages.evidence_note: Four operations routes and support/privacy handling integrated; live operational permissions and persistence verification pending.

stages.title: Data, content and integration completion
stages.evidence_note: Seventh migration with Auth zero-grant onboarding, scoped commands and disclosure/policy draft extensions applied and verified remotely; owner content and provider configuration remain pending.

stages.title: Responsive, Arabic and visual acceptance
stages.evidence_note: 96 public checks and 3 interactions; 88 initial private checks, 24 corrective rechecks and 16 authoring checks with 84 control assertions. Private evidence uses clearly labeled synthetic provider fixtures.

stages.title: Security and end-to-end release verification
stages.evidence_note: Build, formatting, lint and 464 tests pass; 30 SQL scenarios pass against applied migration bytes. Live schema/security checks pass. Real Auth/role acceptance remains pending.

stages.title: Deploy and hand over the finished website
stages.evidence_note: Automatic approval review rejected uploading private source to Vercel without explicit source-transfer authorization. No project or deployment was created.

next_owner_input: Explicit authorization to upload this private repository source to the connected Vercel team for a preview deployment; initial administrator email; secure Supabase dashboard sign-in to configure callback/email settings.
next_engineering_work: After source-transfer authorization, deploy the already prepared verified source, record the preview origin, configure and verify Auth callbacks through an authenticated provider session, then onboard the approved identity and verify actual role workflows.
limitations: No production deployment or live URL established by this checkpoint
No real successful sign-in, invitation/recovery delivery, or hosted role workflow acceptance
SQL tests run in isolated PGlite with synthetic Auth scaffolding; private browser checks use a synthetic provider
Owner-approved notices, public content/contact/privacy facts and independent approval actors remain to be established
Hosting blocked by automatic approval review; real accounts, approved content, provider configuration and live workflow acceptance remain outstanding.

validation.private_browser_scope: local production Next.js and Chromium with an isolated synthetic provider; not live authentication, hosted RLS or persistence evidence
validation.sql_scope: isolated PGlite database with synthetic Auth scaffolding
validation.private_authoring_provider_rpc: Synthetic read-only permission responses; no live Auth or mutation evidence

evidence_finalization: Source committed and tree verified against GitHub; local and database evidence finalized; hosted deployment blocked by automatic approval review.
